title: Manager tactical prior
description: A manager's pre-season statistical fingerprint, expressed as Bayesian priors. Continuous metrics use Normal-Normal conjugate priors (mean, variance, pseudo-observation count). Formation preference uses a Dirichlet-Multinomial prior (counts per formation). This same structure is reused for the POSTERIOR after evidence updates -- prior and posterior share a shape, only the numbers move.

source_seasons.description: Which prior-club seasons fed this prior, for traceability. Each entry cites the club, season, and where the numbers came from.

source.description: e.g. 'fotmob team stats page', 'totalfootballanalysis PPDA article'

continuous_metrics.description: Each key is a tracked metric. mean/variance define uncertainty in the Normal prior for the metric mean. pseudo_n is the prior's weight in virtual matches. Unless observation_variance is supplied explicitly, one match's variance is inferred as variance * pseudo_n, so the default update is equivalent to adding one equally noisy observation to pseudo_n virtual observations.

pseudo_n.description: Prior confidence, in equivalent match count. Default convention: 10.

observation_variance.description: Optional explicit single-match noise variance. If omitted, the update engine infers variance * pseudo_n and persists the inferred value in posterior state.

formation_prior.description: Dirichlet prior over formations: pseudo-counts per formation observed at the prior club. A formation with near-zero count is treated as near-impossible until evidence says otherwise.

style_notes.description: Qualitative descriptors that don't reduce to a single number but matter for the Game Plan narrative (e.g. 'direct/vertical buildup', 'weak at retaining possession under press').
